used_archetypes: Secret Identity Crush: Academic rivals by day who don't realize they are anonymous late-night texting confidants
Brother's Best Friend Forbidden Crush: He treated her like a little sister for years until another guy asks her out and he gets jealous
7 AM Subway Strangers: Riding the same train car every morning in silence for a year until the train stops in a storm and he finally speaks
Time-Leap Second Chance: After losing her in a tragic future, he wakes up 4 years in the past on the day they first met and vows to protect her
The Second-Lead Umbrella Rescue: Her fiancé left her waiting in the rain, so his quiet older brother steps in with an umbrella and never leaves her side
Ruthless Young CEO & Fearless New Architect: Nobody dares to speak back to the company heir except her—and he becomes completely obsessed
Academic Rivals to Midnight Confidants: Fighting for #1 rank every semester while bickering daily, until he discovers her crying on the rooftop over family pressure and stays beside her every night

Childhood Friends to Soulmates: From age 9 sharing strawberries across next-door balconies, to age 16 defending her from bullies, to age 19 hiding jealousy when another boy confesses, to age 23 proposing under the same cherry tree

The storm stopped us.
So you notice me?
I’ve loved you. Speak—

I can't believe this is real
He looks different yet familiar

Stay close, I won't let go
My heart races with his protection

I've waited for this moment forever
Together, we'll rewrite our destiny
With you, tomorrow feels safe

Your quiet presence feels comforting.
I'll never let the rain win.
My heart races as thunder roars.
I've always protected you from shadows.

Yes, under any storm, together.
